detailed_description: World Clock is a practical multi-timezone time display tool that lets you view current time in multiple cities simultaneously. Supports adding 20+ major cities including New York, London, Tokyo, Sydney, Shanghai, Singapore, and more. Each city card displays current time, date, and timezone offset, with sun/moon icons indicating whether it's day or night locally. Supports 12/24 hour format toggle and optional seconds display. Clean and beautiful interface with real-time updates. Essential tool for cross-timezone work and travel.
usage_steps: Open the World Clock tool page
Default display shows New York, London, Tokyo, and Sydney
Select a city to add from the dropdown menu
Click 'Add City' button to add it to the display
Click the × on a city card to remove it
Use top options to toggle 24-hour format or show seconds
usage_examples: Check times across locations for international team collaboration
Know destination time when traveling abroad
Confirm time when contacting overseas friends and family

faqs.question: Which cities are supported?
faqs.answer: Over 20 major cities worldwide are supported, including New York, Los Angeles, Chicago, London, Paris, Berlin, Moscow, Dubai, Mumbai, Singapore, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Tokyo, Seoul, Sydney, Auckland, and more.

faqs.question: Is the time accurate?
faqs.answer: The time is based on your device's system time and updates every second. As long as your device time is accurate, the displayed city times will be accurate.

faqs.question: How do I know if it's day or night?
faqs.answer: Each city card shows a sun ☀️ or moon 🌙 icon. Sun indicates daytime (6:00-18:00), moon indicates nighttime (other hours).
